# Mongoose ODM Documentation

> > Mongoose is an elegant MongoDB object modeling library for Node.js, providing schema-based data validation and query building.

Mongoose is developed by Automattic and originally created by LearnBoost, offering a straightforward way to model application data with MongoDB. The library includes built-in type casting, validation, query building, and business logic hooks, making it the most popular ODM for Node.js applications.

## Key Topics

- Mongoose ODM
- MongoDB object modeling
- Node.js database integration
- Schema definition and validation
- CRUD operations
- Query building and execution
- Model compilation
- Document middleware and hooks
- Virtuals and methods
- Indexes and performance
- Connection management
- Migration guides
- TypeScript support
- Async/await patterns
- Lean queries optimization

## Getting Started

- [Mongoose ODM Homepage](https://mongoosejs.com): Main homepage for Mongoose v9.2.4, MongoDB object modeling for Node.js
- [Getting Started Guide](https://mongoosejs.com/docs): Quick start guide covering MongoDB and Node.js installation, schema creation, and basic usage
- [Getting Started (Detailed)](https://mongoosejs.com/docs/index.html): Comprehensive quick start with schema creation, document methods, and MongoDB queries
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://mongoosejs.com/docs/faq.html): Common issues and solutions: connection errors, IPv6 configuration, unique indexes

## Core Concepts

- [Schemas](https://mongoosejs.com/docs/guide.html): Complete schema guide: definitions, models, methods, virtuals, indexes, and ES6 classes
- [Models](https://mongoosejs.com/docs/8.x/docs/models.html): Models documentation: compiling schemas, CRUD operations, and change streams
- [Queries](https://mongoosejs.com/docs/queries.html): Query building and execution: CRUD helpers, async/await patterns, and query chaining
- [Guides Index](https://mongoosejs.com/docs/guides.html): Complete guides collection: core concepts, integrations, migration guides, and tutorials

## Tutorials

- [Using findOneAndUpdate()](https://mongoosejs.com/docs/tutorials/findoneandupdate.html): Tutorial on findOneAndUpdate() usage, atomic updates, and upsert operations
- [Faster Queries With Lean](https://mongoosejs.com/docs/tutorials/lean.html): Performance optimization tutorial using lean queries for memory efficiency
